Lead profile and technical summary:
- Company: early-stage B2B SaaS (workflow automation for mid-market finance teams).
- Product: in-app chat assistant embedded in web/mobile app for customer support + guided workflows.
- Primary metric: perceived latency (UI streaming) — target median token roundtrip <100ms for US-east users.
- Expected traffic: 60-120 concurrent active users in alpha, scale to 800+ within 6 months.
- Preferred models: smaller low-latency open models (quantized variants), but willing to test larger models for complex flows. Wants transparent perf numbers.

- Quote from CTO: "We need the chat to feel instantaneous — anything over 200ms and retention drops."
- Business: self-serve sign-up already created; team wants 1-week paid pilot to validate perf + quality before commit.
- Decision process: CTO + product lead -> technical PoC -> head of ops signs commercial. Procurement timeline ~May 2026 if POC looks good.
- Risk: cost sensitivity at scale; wants guidance on batching/kv-cache to reduce token spend.
- Red flags: wants guaranteed latency numbers in writing for pilot.

POC scope (agreed):
- 7-day pilot using Redwood Hosted API with streaming enabled.
- Instrumentation: token-level latency metrics, per-route cost breakdown, and example trace links.
- Target KPI: median first-stream token <100ms, 95th percentile <350ms under 100 concurrent simulated users.
